name: Team Apparel & Specialties
old_description: I just wanted to send you a thank you.   Ashley has been so great to work with always.   When I need something done for sports or for work, you guys get it done.   Now that we have added cups and mugs to the mix, along with constant apparel items, it gets so busy and you guys handle it all so great.  The quality on all the items is fantastic.   Thank you for being so great to work with.   You guys are the best.
about:
Team Apparel & Specialties operates from Green Bay, Wisconsin, where it was founded in 1984 by Chris and Gail Docky as a part-time venture that quickly moved to a storefront on Western Avenue. The business remained locally owned and, in April 2008, was purchased by top salesman Travis Herber, who continues as president.

The company provides custom decoration services including screen printing, embroidery, graphic design, CAD printing/wax transfer, and promotional product sourcing. All production is done in-house at a custom facility built in 1993, which houses the largest showroom in the Green Bay area. The shop handles orders ranging from small runs to large volumes for uniforms, team apparel, and branded merchandise.

Clients include schools such as UW‑Green Bay athletics, religious organizations like Life Church, corporate accounts including Packerland Brokerage Services, American‑3 Fab, and JBS, as well as numerous local sports programs and community groups. The company also operates online stores and order-form systems for organizations that want to manage apparel purchasing without inventory.

Team Apparel emphasizes that its 35‑plus years of success stem from long‑term relationships built on trust, fast turnaround enabled by in‑house production, and a mission to deliver the right product at a fair price with reliable service.
